text.en:
Section one hundred ninety-two of Act Numbered Twenty-seven hundred and eleven, known as
the Revised Administrative Code, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 192. Office of register of deeds.-There shall be a register of deeds for the City of Manila and one for
each of the several provinces except the Mountain Province. In the Mountain Province there shall be one
register of deeds for the Mountain Province whose jurisdiction shall extend to such parts of the province as are
not contained in the subprovince of Benguet, and for the subprovince of Benguet there shall be a register of
deeds whose jurisdiction shall extend throughout the subprovince of Benguet, including City of Baguio:
Provided, That the auxiliary register of deeds of the Province of Leyte shall hold office in the municipality of
Maasin, with the same powers and duties as the register of deeds of the province within the municipalities of
Villaba, Palonpon, Merida, Ormoc, Albuera, Baybay, Inopacan, Hindang, Hilongos, Bato, Matalom, Maasin,
Macrohon, Malitbog, Sogod, Libagon, Lilo-an, Pintuyan, Cabalian, Anahawan, Hinunangan, and Hinundayan,
Province of Leyte, subject, however, to the supervision and control of the register of deeds of the province."
All acts or parts of act or laws inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 16, 1931.
